gold.question: Regarding GV-12-2 on the P&ID: Is there a manual override so I can open it without power?

candidate: Yes. GV-12-2 is described as a Type 165 2/2-way solenoid valve, and the documentation for it explicitly lists a manual override among its features ('Service-friendly, robust manual override'), so the valve can be operated manually without power. Note it is a servo-controlled diaphragm valve requiring a minimum differential pressure of about 0.5 bar.

gold.answer: Vibration effect: less than +/-0.1% of URL when tested per IEC 60770-1:1999 field or pipeline with high vibration level (10-60 Hz 0.21 mm displacement peak amplitude / 60-2000 Hz 3g).
gold.question: Regarding FT-11-1 on the P&ID: It's mounted near a compressor with heavy vibration. What vibration limits is it rated for?

candidate: FT-11-1 (a Rosemount 3051 flow transmitter) is tested per IEC 60770-1:1999 for the 'field or pipeline with high vibration level' condition: 0.21 mm peak displacement from 10-60 Hz and 3 g acceleration from 60-2000 Hz. Under that test, the effect on the reading is less than ±0.1 percent of URL (the top of the calibrated span). Note these are test levels and their effect on measurement error; no separate general vibration endurance or shipping vibration rating is given.
